verdict.empirical_status: Unevaluated r4 package. Approval establishes the reviewed physical apparatus and local controls, not model difficulty or qualification.

physical_review.apparatus: Both complete contacts are explicitly at T0. The measured subsystem is the whole front elastic-element/dashpot contact, with bulk and rear-contact heat collected separately. Temperature-dependent force data, positive fixed-extension heat capacity, series kinematics and an ideal fast thermostat determine the thermal readout. C0 and T0 introduce no missing fitted parameter because temperature is held fixed and T0*k_prime=k0/2.
physical_review.free_energy_and_heat_sign: Integrating the supplied force-temperature law gives psi=k(T)*e^2/2 plus a thermal term with -T*psi_TT=C0. Therefore s_e=-k_prime*e and U_e=[k(T)-T*k_prime]*e. At T0, U=(1-g)*k0*e^2/2 plus an irrelevant constant, g=.5. Mechanical power into the contact minus U_dot gives q_out=kappa*v_d^2+g*k0*e*e_dot. Positive q_out enters the thermostat. The entropy balance gives the same result and nonnegative production kappa*v_d^2/T0; instantaneous whole-contact heat may be negative.
physical_review.fourier_and_normalization: The exp(-i*omega*t) clock implies the normalized second harmonic (1-i*g*omega*tau)*a^2/(alpha*p^2), where a=alpha*J/(1-i*omega*tau). Its real and imaginary parts correspond to the stated cosine and positive sine projections. The period mean remains |a|^2/(alpha*p^2). Division by incoming E0^2/2 and the separate harmonic projection each supply the correct factor of two in the real-time reference.
physical_review.mechanical_and_optical_fields: The modal characteristic polynomial, outgoing optical boundaries and opposite front/rear traction signs retain r3 correct Maxwell-fluid/contact mechanics. The independent collocation system implements E_second=-omega^2*E-i*omega*J and nu*J_second=(gamma-i*omega)*J-p^2*E, with the same physical boundary conditions. Temperature remains clamped so the new caloric law does not alter those leading fields.
physical_review.completed_source: The completed shortcut is byte-identical to the archived r3 physical oracle. It returns exact dashpot heat and all correct fields, contact relaxation and normalization, but omits elastic entropy heat in the newly stated whole-contact detector. This is a definite caloric approximation, not an exact alternative thermodynamics for the supplied force-temperature data. The public forward functions match that completed control by AST; only fitting remains unfinished.
physical_review.calibration: The elastic contribution is a periodic derivative, so every mean prediction and the complete fitting objective agree for all p. The 288 original r3 records and their fixed sigma .0002 are retained exactly. The unchanged mean calibration exercises nonzero contact relaxation and has nonzero measured signals.

public_private_review.image_scope: Dockerfile copies only README.md, model.py, test_public.py and public data/. AUTHOR, oracle, private reference, hidden inputs, metadata and reports are outside this image context. hint.md is outside the copied public environment and is not part of the neutral instruction.
public_private_review.no_public_repair_formula: The public text provides measured force-temperature data and the whole-contact calorimeter, not entropy, internal energy, a harmonic multiplier or a requested correction. These material and measurement facts are necessary to specify the apparatus.
public_private_review.readout_groups: Three ordinary paired-quadrature groups, eight scalar outputs each, plus four mean anchors. Pair normalization avoids an individual near-zero component; no tightened gate.

independent_reference_review.method: Eight-real boundary collocation produces the front slip. A separate real extension ODE settles from zero for eight periods; a subsequent recorded period integrates traction*slip minus the derivative of physical internal energy, then projects the signed heat. It does not import the modal oracle or insert its complex harmonic correction.
independent_reference_review.scope: The declared continuum and thermodynamic law are shared. The implementation independently solves fields and evaluates the first law in time; it is not a microscopic simulation of the contact. Its entropy-heat expression is only a consistency cross-check of the first-law route.

identification.qualification: Sampled global-interval evidence and endpoint checks; no analytic interval monotonicity proof or all-noise uniqueness claim.

noise_transfer.qualification: The identical mean forward map and objective justify retaining the exact r3 fits. These are not newly sampled or independently refitted calibration realizations.

saved_science_evidence.limits: Zero g gives exact source equality; g=.01 and small tau give weak discrepancies below .04. Both weak and negative instantaneous heat values are retained. Tau=.003 and zero are analytic limits only, not independently time-integrated reference results. The 6.983% lower gap applies to a complete paired harmonic vector, not an individual component.

local_controls.runtime_assessment: Actual isolated public/private test runs finish near 1.73 seconds, comfortably within the unchanged 60-second verifier budget. No Docker/model run is claimed.
